extraction_note: The careers page embeds the linked public JSON feed. All 56 entries were read. Status is a dated observation, not a continuing claim of vacancy availability. Full job descriptions are not redistributed.
normalization_notes: Three Procurement Intern postings share responsibilities and map to one procurement assistant.
Madrid and Singapore Forward Deployed Engineer postings share responsibilities and map to one applied AI role.
English and German technical customer-support postings map to one role with their combined installation and L2 support scope.
Intern and working-student postings become supervised assistant agents; geography and employer brands are not agent identities.
The two IoT product-lead roles remain distinct: the combined role includes agent-platform foundation responsibilities.
